hints.title: Base-X Digit Representation Expansion
hints.text: Represent target in base x. Each digit d at position k can either be formed by adding d powers of x, or by overshooting with d + 1 and subtracting remainder.

hints.title: Two-Choice Carry DP Transitions
hints.text: At power level k: cost to write x^k is k operators (or 2 when k = 0). For each digit d, evaluate transition without carry (d * cost) versus with carry ((x - d) * cost) passing carry 1 to next power.

hints.title: Recursive Digit Decomposition Blueprint
hints.text: Define dp(target, k): if target == 0 return 0. If target == 1 return cost(k). Compute remainder r = target % x, quotient q = target // x. Return min(r * cost(k) + dp(q, k+1), (x - r) * cost(k) + dp(q + 1, k+1)).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Logarithmic number of power levels with at most two subproblems per level (floor and ceiling).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first search exploring arithmetic trees explodes combinatorially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoized recursion bounds unique evaluated subproblem states to O(log_x Target).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulating choice between additive floor and subtractive ceiling at each base-x power.
